description: Governed CVSS 3.1 base vectors for configuration checks, which carry no CVE and so no published vector. One vector per check ID, decided once by a named person and reviewed by a date; the VDR builder applies it to every finding of that check. It drives PAIN (CVSS-Environmental) and LEV (Figure 7: the floor, and the no-direct-impact rule). An entry without decided_by and decided_on is a proposal and is NOT in force; an entry past review_by lapses. Vectors marked AI-drafted were proposed for operator review.

AVD-AWS-0015.rationale: CloudTrail logs SSE-S3 instead of a customer-managed key: encrypted at rest; key custody only.

AVD-AWS-0089.rationale: Bucket access logging off: reduces detection only.

AVD-AWS-0132.rationale: SSE-S3 instead of a customer-managed key: data is encrypted at rest; key custody choice only.

AVD-AWS-0162.rationale: CloudTrail not streamed to CloudWatch Logs: reduces alerting only.

CKV2_AWS_10.rationale: CloudTrail not streamed to CloudWatch Logs: trail still written; reduces alerting only.

CKV2_AWS_47.rationale: No Log4j WAF managed rule: no Log4j in the stack, so the absent rule protects nothing exploitable.

CKV2_AWS_56.rationale: Administrator policy on the operator group: a compromised operator credential controls the account.

CKV2_AWS_62.rationale: S3 event notifications off: reduces detection only.

CKV_AWS_115.rationale: No reserved concurrency: a request flood can exhaust account concurrency for other functions.

CKV_AWS_117.rationale: Lambda outside a VPC: network-isolation depth; the function's own permissions bound what it reaches.

CKV_AWS_119.rationale: DynamoDB default encryption instead of a customer-managed key: encrypted at rest; key custody only.

CKV_AWS_144.rationale: S3 cross-region replication off: resilience only.

CKV_AWS_145.rationale: SSE-S3 instead of a customer-managed key: data is encrypted at rest; key custody choice only.

CKV_AWS_174.rationale: No Log4j-specific WAF rule: no Log4j in the stack, so the absent rule protects nothing exploitable.

CKV_AWS_18.rationale: S3 access logging off on a log-target bucket: reduces detection; gives an attacker no capability.

CKV_AWS_23.rationale: S3 event notifications off: reduces detection only.

CKV_AWS_252.rationale: CloudTrail SNS delivery notifications off: no consumer; no attacker capability.

CKV_AWS_272.rationale: No code signing: a holder of deploy rights can ship unsigned code.

CKV_AWS_287.rationale: Secrets metadata reads on a wildcard: a holder of the role can list secret metadata, not values.

CKV_AWS_310.rationale: CloudFront origin failover absent: resilience only.

CKV_AWS_35.rationale: CloudTrail logs SSE-S3 instead of a customer-managed key: encrypted at rest; key custody only.

CKV_AWS_355.rationale: Wildcard resource in a read-only assessment policy: a holder of the role can read more metadata than needed.

CKV_AWS_356.rationale: Wildcard resource for account-level enumeration: a holder of the role can enumerate the account.

CKV_AWS_374.rationale: CloudFront geo restriction off on a public site: no capability beyond the site's intended exposure.

CKV_AWS_50.rationale: Lambda X-Ray tracing off: observability only.

CKV_AWS_68.rationale: No WAF on a public distribution: request floods and application attacks meet no edge filter; availability impact.

CKV_AWS_86.rationale: CloudFront origin failover absent: resilience only.
